## Questions I Would Ask (With My Assumptions)

1. **What events trigger notifications?** → *Assuming: account activity, content updates, system alerts*
2. **Which channels?** → *Assuming: in-app, email, push notifications*
3. **User control over preferences?** → *Assuming: yes, granular control required*
4. **Real-time or batched?** → *Assuming: real-time for critical, digest option for others*
5. **Read/unread tracking?** → *Assuming: yes, with mark-all-read*

---

## Technical Enabler Stories

**E1: Notification Infrastructure** (8 points)
- As a *developer*, I want a notification service foundation, so that all notification types have consistent delivery.
- **Acceptance Criteria:**
  - Database schema for notifications (user_id, type, payload, read_status, created_at)
  - Message queue integration for async processing
  - API endpoint structure defined
  - Service handles 1000 notifications/minute
- **Dependencies:** None

---

## User Stories (Prioritized Order)

**S1: In-App Notification Display** (5 points)
- As a *user*, I want to see notifications in the app, so that I'm aware of important activity.
- **AC:** Bell icon shows unread count | Dropdown lists last 20 notifications | Clicking notification navigates to relevant content | Timestamps displayed relatively | Works on web and mobile
- **Dependencies:** E1

**S2: Mark Notifications Read** (2 points)
- As a *user*, I want to mark notifications as read, so that I can track what I've reviewed.
- **AC:** Individual mark-as-read on click | "Mark all read" button | Read state persists across sessions | Visual distinction between read/unread
- **Dependencies:** S1

**S3: Email Notifications** (5 points)
- As a *user*, I want to receive email notifications, so that I'm informed when not using the app.
- **AC:** Emails sent for high-priority events | Unsubscribe link in footer | Email template renders correctly | Rate-limited to prevent spam | Uses existing user email
- **Dependencies:** E1

**S4: Notification Preferences** (5 points)
- As a *user*, I want to control my notification settings, so that I only receive relevant alerts.
- **AC:** Settings page accessible from profile | Toggle per notification type | Toggle per channel (in-app, email) | Preferences persist immediately | Default preferences set on registration
- **Dependencies:** S1, S3

**S5: Push Notifications - Mobile** (5 points)
- As a *mobile user*, I want push notifications, so that I receive alerts without opening the app.
- **AC:** Permission prompt on first launch | Respects user preferences | Badge count syncs with unread | Works on iOS and Android | Deep links to relevant content
- **Dependencies:** E1, S4

---

## Sprint Allocation

**Sprint 1 (18 points):** E1, S1, S2 — *Foundation and core experience*
**Sprint 2 (15 points):** S3, S4, S5 — *Channels and user control*

Everything proceeds according to my sprint plan. The PM will find their vague epic transformed into actionable precision.
